decisions.reason: As a newly launched and publicly announced security feature that complements the super-app ecosystem, management is likely to justify continued support and treat any weak uptake as temporary.
Because an identity-bound wallet fits the firm's stated push toward secure multi-service ecosystems and regulated customer use cases, management is likely to persist with it after its recent launch.

Although more niche than the platform-level offers, the authenticator still draws on the firm's core identity and access expertise, so management would likely keep it rather than reverse course so soon.
A secure payment and wallet framework is highly consistent with the firm's integrated platform strategy and visible market commitment, which lowers the chance of withdrawal.
This product is closest to the firm's announced strategic direction around secure super-app ecosystems, so escalation of commitment strongly favors retaining it.
The application shielding library leverages longstanding security capabilities and has its own dedicated presentation, making management inclined to continue backing it despite any early uncertainty.
